description: BTP Subaccount Lifecycle & Drift Tracker — XSUAA security descriptor

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.LifecycleViewer
scopes.description: Read access to subaccount inventory, drift reports, and audit trail

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.LifecycleAdmin
scopes.description: Write access: configure drift baselines and ignore-rules per landscape tier

role-templates.name: LifecycleViewer
role-templates.description: View subaccount inventory, drift findings, and audit-log activity timelines

role-templates.name: LifecycleAdmin
role-templates.description: All viewer rights plus the ability to manage drift baselines and ignore-rules

role-collections.name: BTP Subaccount Lifecycle Viewer
role-collections.description: Read-only access to the Subaccount Lifecycle & Drift Tracker

role-collections.name: BTP Subaccount Lifecycle Administrator
role-collections.description: Full access including baseline and ignore-rule configuration
